description: This Java class 'GenericHelperInfo' encapsulates data source connection information, including fields for entity group, helper base, tenant ID, JDBC URI, username, password, and full name. It provides getters and setters for managing these properties, with some logic for concatenating tenant ID to form the full helper name.

classes.name: GenericHelperInfo
classes.description: A final class that contains data source connection details such as entity group, helper base, tenant ID, JDBC URI, username, password, and a constructed helper full name.

methods.name: GenericHelperInfo
methods.description: Constructor initializing entityGroupName and helperBaseName, setting the helperFullName initially to helperBaseName.

methods.name: getHelperFullName
methods.description: Returns the full name of the helper, potentially including tenant ID.

methods.name: getEntityGroupName
methods.description: Returns the name of the entity group.

methods.name: getHelperBaseName
methods.description: Returns the base name of the helper.

methods.name: setTenantId
methods.description: Sets the tenant ID and updates the helper full name to include it.

methods.name: getOverrideJdbcUri
methods.description: Returns the overridden JDBC URI, or a default value if not set.

methods.name: getOverrideJdbcUri
methods.description: Overloaded method; returns the overridden JDBC URI or provided default.

methods.name: getOverrideUsername
methods.description: Returns the override username, or a default value if not set.

methods.name: getOverrideUsername
methods.description: Overloaded method; returns the override username or provided default.
